name: @cf/llava-hf/llava-1.5-7b-hf
description: LLaVA is an open-source chatbot trained by fine-tuning LLaMA/Vicuna on GPT-generated multimodal instruction-following data. It is an auto-regressive language model, based on the transformer architecture.

task.name: Image-to-Text
task.description: Image to text models output a text from a given image. Image captioning or optical character recognition can be considered as the most common applications of image to text.

oneOf.description: Binary image contents. Uses the default prompt and generation settings.

image.description: Image contents as an array of unsigned 8-bit integers.

prompt.description: Question or instruction about the image.

raw.description: Use prompt verbatim instead of applying the LLaVA chat template. When true, prompt must contain exactly one <image> placeholder.

max_tokens.description: Maximum generated tokens, capped to the remaining context-window space.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Set to 0 for greedy decoding.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling probability. Must be greater than 0 when temperature is greater than 0.

top_k.description: Top-k sampling limit. Set to 0 to disable.

repetition_penalty.description: Repetition penalty multiplier. Must be strictly positive.

frequency_penalty.description: Penalty proportional to each token's frequency in generated text.

presence_penalty.description: Penalty applied to tokens already present in generated text.

seed.description: Optional random seed for reproducible generation.

description.description: Generated description or answer about the image.
